Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Good news: we can do a co-term top-up that aligns to your renewal on Mar 31. High level options: 

1) Co-term amendment (recommended): add +16 GPUs to existing reserved pool, term ends 2028-03-31. Billing: single prorated charge now to cover remainder of the month, then one invoice at renewal for the 12‑month term (preferred by many customers for clean procurement).
